.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.yml

name: Feature request
description: Describe a workflow or an option that would help you.
title: "[Idea] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
body:
  - type: markdown
    attributes:
      value: |
        Read the README roadmap first. Describe the situation, the intended outcome and any relevant device or content type. Keep personal information out of examples and attachments.
  - type: textarea
    id: situation
    attributes:
      label: What are you trying to do?
      description: Explain the workflow and what makes it difficult today.
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: proposal
    attributes:
      label: What would help?
  - type: textarea
    id: outcome
    attributes:
      label: What would a successful result look like?
      description: A concrete example helps us document and test the intended behaviour.
  - type: dropdown
    id: context
    attributes:
      label: Where would you use it?
      options:
        - TV and web
        - Mainly on the TV
        - Mainly in the browser
        - Background engine or scheduled work
        - Not sure
  - type: dropdown
    id: product
    attributes:
      label: Product
      options:
        - PS5 Backup Center
        - PS5 Center (future project)
        - PS5 Connector (future concept)
        - PS4 Backup Center (future project)
        - Not sure
